newsitem.title: UK: Vintage wine collection sells for record $1.02 mln.
newsitem.headline: Vintage wine collection sells for record $1.02 mln.

text.p: A British wine firm said on Wednesday it sold the world's most expensive single-chateau collection to a Las Vegas hotel casino for $1.02 million.

Stephen Williams, owner of The Antique Wine Company, said the Rio Suite Hotel and Casino paid the seven-figure sum for 127 bottles of Chateau d'Yquem, a dessert wine from France, from a collection that included every vintage between 1855 and 1990.

"Las Vegas is a very important market for our company. When we heard The Rio had appointed the president of the Court of Master Sommeliers, Barrie Larvin, to their food and beverage department we knew that they were going to be making big waves in the wine world," Williams said in a statement.
Details of the unique sale will be provided to the Guinness Book of Records for possible inclusion in the wine section of its next edition, a spokeswoman said.
